title: Stored ember glands carried from The Experiment Research Station to the Hex Star bid (Dheneb, lawless)
note: Written by Apophis 2026-11-17 12:11 UTC (orders ENT-036, block APOPHIS: what a kill yields is sold where a bid stands). Hex Star (Dheneb) bid 3,919 cr x 37 for ember glands at 11:49 UTC, rising from 3,692 x 46 at 09:17 UTC; every home station bids 480. The Achernar cinder-sylph hunt looted 17 glands in 8 runs from 08:20 UTC. A pilot whose own storage at The Experiment Research Station holds 6 glands or more withdraws them and sells at Hex Star at 2,000 cr or more, no more units than stand at the best price. 9 jumps through lawless space; no pirate on our record on the road or one jump from it (observations kind pirate, 12:10 UTC). Goods aboard (rule F13): 6 glands are some 2,900 cr at the home bid against about 23,500 at Hex Star. What it does not sell stays aboard and is stored at home by store-hold-central-nexus. A test with one ship: read its RESULT line next turn.
